$comment: editor-ia-starter-kit settings. The agent reads this file at the start of every task. Keys never go here; they go in .env.

$profiles.solo: One agent on the pro model does everything: taste, design, cuts, render.
$profiles.team: The pro model orchestrates and makes every design decision. Flash-tier subagents run mechanical, parallel work: transcripts, probes, validators, contact sheets.

models.$engineer: character-film only: writes and fixes engine code and measurement, never taste.

transcription.$languages: Languages spoken in your footage: ["es"], ["en"] or ["en","es"]. One language picks a fixed Whisper model; both lets Whisper detect per file.

$providers.whisper: npm run transcribe -- <video>  (local, free; the fallback when no key is set)
$providers.elevenlabs: npm run transcribe -- <video>  (used when provider is elevenlabs and ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is set in .env; Scribe word times are measured)

defaults.$goal: personal | sell | grow. Empty means the agent asks per project.

music.$comment: Drop royalty-free tracks you own the rights to in music/ (or brands/<slug>/music/ for one brand). The agent picks from there when no music key is set.
